sections.title: Why Book SOS for Your San Francisco Move
sections.content: Comparing San Francisco moving companies for a move to or from Los Angeles? SOS Moving provides moving services between San Francisco and LA in both directions from our Los Angeles headquarters, with a plan for steep blocks, walk-up flats and reserved curb space. What backs every booking: Stairs and carries: Stairs, long carries and a second stop are planned into the quote up front, so a top-floor walk-up is not a surprise line item on moving day. Licensed Carrier: CPUC licensed, CAL-T0192140, USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871, with full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Client Ratings: Rated 4.9 on Google across 1,007 reviews. Call 909-443-0004 Monday through Sunday, 8AM to 6PM, or request a free estimate online.

sections.title: Packing for the Hills and the Highway
sections.content: On a San Francisco move, boxes often travel down stairs and up a truck ramp parked on a slope before the long highway ride. Our packing services prepare your things for both. How we prep your belongings: Wrapped Furniture: Sofas, dressers and tables go into moving blankets and shrink wrap before they leave the room. Wardrobe Boxes: Hanging clothes travel upright in wardrobe boxes, so closets unpack without a pile of wrinkled shirts. Take-Apart Pieces: Bed frames and tables are disassembled to clear tight stairways, and TVs come off the wall and get packed. Heavy items are priced up front: $200 for a piano and $150 for anything heavier than 300 lbs.

sections.title: San Francisco to Los Angeles Moves
sections.content: Leaving the Bay Area for Southern California? Our long-distance movers load at your San Francisco door, head south on I-5 and carry everything into your new Los Angeles home. How the move south works: Reserved Curb: SFMTA temporary tow-away signs can hold curb space for the moving truck, and cars left in the posted zone can be towed. Hill Parking: On a grade, the truck is parked the way SFMTA rules call for, with wheels curbed and the parking brake set. Winter Backup: When the CHP closes the Grapevine for ice, US-101 through San Luis Obispo and Santa Barbara is the other way south. List the stairs at both addresses when you request your free estimate, and we will plan the day around them.

sections.title: Los Angeles to San Francisco Moves
sections.content: Heading north to the city? Our long-distance crew makes the drive of about 380 miles, up I-5 over the Grapevine and through the Central Valley, then across Altamont Pass and the Bay Bridge into San Francisco. What the San Francisco end can involve: Steep Blocks: Blocks like Filbert Street on Russian Hill rank among the steepest in the city, so truck placement is planned before arrival. Garage-Level Homes: Many Sunset District houses put the living floor above a street-level garage, so furniture goes up a flight of stairs. Stair-Only Addresses: Some Telegraph Hill homes along the Filbert Steps have no car access, so every box is carried in by hand. Want the boxes done before the truck leaves LA? Add professional packing to your pickup day.

sections.title: Office Moves Between LA and San Francisco
sections.content: Moving an office or a satellite team between Los Angeles and San Francisco? Our commercial movers pack workstations, files and equipment at one end and reassemble them at the other.

faq.question: How do I reserve curb space for a moving truck in San Francisco?
faq.answer: If the curb outside your building is usually full, you can reserve space with SFMTA temporary tow-away signs, which the agency issues for moving vans. Apply through the SFMTA online portal, and apply early because processing takes several business days. After approval the SFMTA posts the signs, and vehicles parked in the zone can be towed.

faq.question: My San Francisco flat is a walk-up with no elevator. Will the stairs cost extra?
faq.answer: No. Stairs and long carries are planned into the quote before the truck is loaded, whether you live on a top floor in North Beach or above a garage in the Sunset. Tell us the flights of stairs at both ends when you book, so the crew size and the estimate match the job.

faq.question: Which route does the truck take between Los Angeles and San Francisco?
faq.answer: The fastest option runs about 380 miles, mostly on I-5 through the Central Valley, climbing the Grapevine at Tejon Pass. US-101 through Santa Barbara, San Luis Obispo and Salinas is longer, and it serves as the fallback when the CHP closes the Grapevine for winter ice.

faq.question: What does a move between Los Angeles and San Francisco cost?
faq.answer: A move over that distance is quoted as a flat rate rather than by the hour: the price follows how much you are moving and how much packing you want, not the clock. Call 909-443-0004 or request a free estimate to get the figure for your inventory; the $50 deposit is applied toward the total, and the $30 gas fee is separate.
